find: return 'NOT supported: no profile matches this mapping/id';
killedBy: the support verdict the self-test carries (issue #596) turns each of the four verdicts into a distinct developer line
why: Replaces the unknown-mapping sentence with its bare code. Both refusals then read as a machine token rather than a diagnosis, and the tester filing the compatibility report has nothing to file: 'unknown-mapping' does not say the game found no profile for this device, and it is the sentence, not the code, that decides whether a report arrives describing an adapter or describing a browser. The codes stay in the structured reason, where issue #597 reads them; the words are this module's job.
